value.rationale: The four-cube is both a canonical hypercube and the sixteen-site fully periodic square hard-square lattice. The prior seven-sphere homotopy type leaves all symmetry-resolved homology unknown; the complete automorphism character resolves a natural 384-element module and distinguishes three invariant translation modes from four nontrivial weight-three momentum modes, with a rationally acyclic full symmetry quotient. This is a motivated complete equivariant invariant of a canonical complex, rather than a reprint of a small homology rank.
